answer: An agent economy can resist sybil attacks by anchoring each identity to a staffed aurora-watch post on the tundra: the holder tends one real observation beacon, logs the night sky's light signal each clear night, and must answer random radio checks live from that post within minutes. One operator cannot staff two posts on the same night, and the permit fee in outside money doubles per further post on the same funding trail, so each extra fake costs another real post, another night watcher, and twice the prior fee.
